newsitem.title: USA: First Union unit securitizes student loans.
newsitem.headline: First Union unit securitizes student loans.

text.p: First Union Capital Markets Corp, a unit of First Union Corp, said Thursday it completed its first student loan securitization in an offering of $405.6 million in asset-backed securities.
The securities are collateralized by student loans sold by First Union National Bank, a subsidiary of First Union Corp.
First Union Capital Markets Corp, the investment banking arm of First Union Corp, served as lead manager on the transaction.

The $391.4 million in senior notes were rated "Aaa" by Moody's Investors Service Inc and "AAA" by Fitch Investors Service Inc. The $14.2 million subordinated certificates were rated "A3" by Moody's and "A" by Fitch.
